Dimension systems

Source: R/physics-units-dimensions.R
DimensionSystem.Rd

DimensionSystem(base_dims, derived_dims, dimensional_dependencies) is SymPy's coherent set of dimensions: the base dimensions, the derived ones and how the derived ones depend on the base ones. Dimensions may be given as Dimension objects or names, and dimensional_dependencies as a named list such as list(velocity = list(length = 1, time = -1)), a list of list(dimension, dependencies) pairs, or a units_dict. get_dimensional_dependencies() expresses a dimension through the base dimensions as a units_dict (fields k and v hold the keys and the powers, in Python's dict order); equivalent_dims() compares two dimensions that way and is_dimensionless() tests for no dependencies. extend() adds base and derived dimensions. The other functions are the legacy helpers of SymPy (list_can_dims, dim_can_vector, ...).

Usage

DimensionSystem(
  base_dims,
  derived_dims = list(),
  dimensional_dependencies = list()
)

base_dims(dim_sys)

derived_dims(dim_sys)

dimensional_dependencies(dim_sys)

get_dimensional_dependencies(dim_sys, name, mark_dimensionless = FALSE)

equivalent_dims(dim_sys, dim1, dim2)

extend(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'DimensionSystem'
extend(x, new_base_dims, new_derived_dims = list(), new_dim_deps = NULL, ...)

is_dimensionless(dim_sys, dimension)

list_can_dims(dim_sys)

dim_can_vector(dim_sys, dim)

inv_can_transf_matrix(dim_sys)

can_transf_matrix(dim_sys)

dim_vector(dim_sys, dim)

print_dim_base(dim_sys, dim)

system_dim(x)

is_consistent(x)

Arguments

base_dims, new_base_dims

Base dimensions.

derived_dims, new_derived_dims

Derived dimensions.

dimensional_dependencies, new_dim_deps

Dependencies of the derived dimensions.

dim_sys, x

A DimensionSystem (or, for extend(), system_dim() and is_consistent(), a UnitSystem).

name, dim, dim1, dim2, dimension

Dimensions or dimension expressions.

mark_dimensionless

Return {Dimension(1): 1} for a dimensionless input.

...

Further arguments of the UnitSystem method.

Value

A DimensionSystem, units_dict, list, matrix, expression, integer or TRUE/FALSE.

Examples

u <- physics_units()
get_dimensional_dependencies(u$dimsys_SI, u$force)
#> {Dimension(mass): 1, Dimension(length): 1, Dimension(time): -2}
equivalent_dims(u$dimsys_SI, u$energy, u$force * u$length)
#> [1] TRUE
ds <- DimensionSystem(list(u$length, u$time), list(u$velocity))
base_dims(ds)
#> [[1]]
#> Dimension(length, L)
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> Dimension(time, T)
#>
